trace.purpose: Find model year and powertrain combination with highest average warranty cost per vehicle delivered including vehicles with no claims

WITH warranty_cost_per_vehicle AS (
  SELECT
    v.model_year,
    v.powertrain,
    COUNT(DISTINCT v.vin) AS vehicles_delivered,
    COALESCE(SUM(w.cost_eur), 0) AS total_warranty_cost
  FROM gishub.fleet.vehicles v

  model_year,
  powertrain,
  total_warranty_cost / vehicles_delivered AS avg_warranty_cost_per_vehicle
FROM warranty_cost_per_vehicle
ORDER BY avg_warranty_cost_per_vehicle DESC

WITH last_quarter_range AS (
  SELECT 
    CASE 
      WHEN MONTH(current_date) IN (1, 2, 3) THEN DATE(CONCAT(YEAR(current_date) - 1, '-10-01'))
      WHEN MONTH(current_date) IN (4, 5, 6) THEN DATE(CONCAT(YEAR(current_date), '-01-01'))
      WHEN MONTH(current_date) IN (7, 8, 9) THEN DATE(CONCAT(YEAR(current_date), '-04-01'))
      ELSE DATE(CONCAT(YEAR(current_date), '-07-01')) 
    END AS start_date,
    CASE 
      WHEN MONTH(current_date) IN (1, 2, 3) THEN DATE(CONCAT(YEAR(current_date) - 1, '-12-31'))
      WHEN MONTH(current_date) IN (4, 5, 6) THEN DATE(CONCAT(YEAR(current_date), '-03-31'))
      WHEN MONTH(current_date) IN (7, 8, 9) THEN DATE(CONCAT(YEAR(current_date), '-06-30'))
      ELSE DATE(CONCAT(YEAR(current_date), '-09-30')) 
    END AS end_date
)

FROM gishub.fleet.vehicles v
